rendering_contract: Candidate wording for S45 deterministic distribution rendering; each queried state has a branch, all probabilities remain visible. No probability threshold or posterior-ranked treatment selection is defined. Discussion and review only; no product selection.
disclosures: Experimental, uncalibrated and unapproved; not a prescription and not a product selection.
A preference discussion alone never selects treatment; indication review requires clinician synthesis of preference, adherence and scenario context.
Undecided, uncertain and not-established values are explicit known inputs, not missing data; unknown, not-assessed, missing or conflicting required input pauses.
Missing, unknown, not-assessed or conflicting required input pauses; a false gate is not_applicable and claims no posterior.
